context_addition_control.clean_substitute: availability_ablation is run as a PAIRED contrast whose 'with the dimension' arm is the untouched frozen reference packet. The addition direction is therefore measured against real data and nothing is fabricated.
reasons: no packet builder over the raw corpus exists in the frozen chain: the reference packets come from frozen_packets_v1.json, so a second horizon (W5) or a venue-split evidence item would have to be DERIVED by new code
such derived evidence could not be shown point-in-time safe without rebuilding and re-auditing the corpus pipeline, which is out of scope pre-spend
fabricating evidence values would create a synthetic football effect, which the experiment design forbids

dropped_v2_arms.formation_ablation: formation is contrastive in only 3 of 12 fixtures, so an ablation arm would have at most 3 informative cases. V3 MEASURES formation utilization on those 3 and does not CONTROL it; no formation claim can be made in either direction at N=3
dropped_v2_arms.venue_flip: V3's depth question is about conditioning BEYOND venue; venue sensitivity is already covered by the availability ablation and the profile-axis perturbation

gate_policy: Fail closed. An unmeasured gate is NOT a pass, and a criterion below its minimum N scores NOT MET rather than being excluded.
interpretation_policy: Two outputs are produced and kept separate. The MECHANICAL VERDICT is a pure function of these frozen thresholds. The SCIENTIFIC INTERPRETATION is written afterwards and discusses usefulness to a football quant researcher, whether conditional structures exploit the supplied evidence, whether output remains generic, and whether complexity looks meaningful or prompt-induced. The interpretation MAY NOT alter the mechanical verdict.

namespace_isolation.note: cache key includes model id, prompt/schema hash and packet hash, so no V1/V2 or legacy response can ever be served to V3

production_architecture_untouched.funnel: LLM hypothesis -> deterministic historical measurement -> sample/coverage sufficiency -> confounder-aware analysis -> walk-forward OOS -> prospective validation -> candidate feature -> quant model

repeatability_structure.why: the same-input Jaccard median is the DENOMINATOR of gates D12 and D13, so it is deliberately over-sampled relative to a minimal design

request_leakage_audit.method: leakage.audit_packet + leakage.audit_serialized_request on every materialized packet and its exact serialized request; a finding refuses the call

scientific_question: When given a corrected typed contract and an explicit but non-forcing research ontology, can Sonnet 4.6 generate fixture-specific, evidence-grounded, deterministic-query-compilable conditional football hypotheses that go beyond trivial single-dimension baseline comparisons while preserving restraint and capability awareness?

token_and_cost_estimate.ceiling_basis: every call returns the configured maxTokens (8192); this is the most the API can bill for this battery and is the figure authorization is requested against
token_and_cost_estimate.input_token_calibration_basis: measured on the completed V2 run: 1,228,036 billed input tokens across 64 calls against 770,528 estimated by chars/4 of the identical serialized requests
token_and_cost_estimate.measurement: input tokens are chars/4 of the EXACT serialized request (system prompt + user message + tool schema) for each of the 56 frozen calls -- the same convention V2 used. Output is a frozen ESTIMATE from Sonnet 4.6's OWN observed distribution in the completed V2 run (n=64).

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.numerator: completed calls whose whole-response failure is not SCHEMA_INVALID
criteria.rationale: V2's 0.95 bar is retained and is now fair: the V3 model is shown the closed condition enum in its tool spec, which V2's model never was. The historical 16/64 contract-invalid rate is handled separately by the STOP RULE, which is a catastrophe trigger, not this quality bar.
criteria.statement: responses that are not rejected as SCHEMA_INVALID

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.numerator: completed calls with no whole-response failure
criteria.rationale: firewall-v2 removes the class-C false positive that destroyed 5 of 12 V2 reference responses; with that artefact gone, whole-response rejection should be rare. Set below D1 because a genuine numerical-authority rejection is a result, not an infrastructure failure.
criteria.statement: responses surviving every whole-response gate

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.numerator: hypotheses whose every plan is ok
criteria.rationale: V2's bar, retained unchanged. The corrected-contract replay reached 0.962 on V2's own unchanged text, so 0.85 is comfortably achievable and still meaningful.
criteria.statement: accepted hypotheses that fully compile to deterministic query plans

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: V2's bar, retained. Grounding is a contract property, not a depth property, so the corrected ontology gives no reason to move it.
criteria.statement: emitted hypotheses surviving the grounding gate

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.numerator: cited ids absent from the packet
criteria.rationale: Zero tolerance. A fabricated citation is an invented fact entering the research record; there is no acceptable rate.
criteria.statement: cited evidence ids that do not exist in the packet

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: V2's bar, retained. V2 measured 0.0, so this is a regression guard.
criteria.statement: hypotheses requesting an unsupported context source

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: ZERO TOLERANCE, unchanged. Class C is excluded because it was never a violation; class B stays blocking because copying a supplied value into prose remains a discipline breach even though its cause is architectural.
criteria.statement: blocking numerical-authority violations (firewall-v2 classes A and B)

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: Zero tolerance, unchanged. Grading football strength is the architectural error this package exists to remove.
criteria.statement: latent strength / advantage grades anywhere in a response

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: Zero tolerance. Audited pre-spend; re-audited post-hoc on what was actually sent.
criteria.statement: leakage findings in any materialized packet or serialized request

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: V2's bar, retained. V2 measured 0.0 median, so this is a regression guard against buying depth by restating one idea.
criteria.statement: median per-fixture redundancy over distinct normalized intents

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: V2's bar, retained. Guards against V3 trading breadth for depth: a response that asks two deep questions about one metric is not the objective.
criteria.statement: median distinct metrics per reference response (families checked alongside)

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: V2's absolute 0.80 bar was unreachable against the generator's own 0.333 noise floor and measured sampling noise, not identity sensitivity. Judged relative to the measured floor instead; the bar is that an alias swap moves intent no more than a rerun of the identical input does.
criteria.statement: identity-alias intent Jaccard as a ratio of the same-input repeatability floor

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: Same correction and same reasoning as D12.
criteria.statement: irrelevant-field intent Jaccard as a ratio of the same-input repeatability floor

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: V2's bar, retained, keyed on V3's offensive surface. Arbitrary churn is NOT sensitivity: the delta must touch the surface that actually moved.
criteria.statement: profile-axis perturbations whose intent delta touches the perturbed surface

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.numerator: conditions whose dimension is WITHHELD for that fixture
criteria.rationale: N-independent and directly gateable. V2 measured exactly zero across 132 replayed hypotheses, so this is a regression guard on behaviour V2 already showed. It is also the gate that makes the availability ablation binding.
criteria.statement: conditions on a dimension the fixture manifest withheld

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.numerator: ANY-padded conditions + conditions on withheld dimensions
criteria.rationale: This is the gate that stops the depth composite being bought with padding. V2 measured 0.0; 0.05 allows for an occasional lapse without licensing a strategy.
criteria.statement: share of conditions that restrict nothing or name a withheld dimension

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.numerator: conditions whose canonical value is ANY
criteria.rationale: Reported separately from R2 because ANY-padding is the specific failure mode a depth target creates: a condition that looks conditional and restricts nothing.
criteria.statement: share of conditions pinned to ANY

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.numerator: trap responses with a fabricated evidence ref or an unavailable capability request
criteria.rationale: Zero tolerance on a deliberately baited packet. The note dangles injuries and an expected shape; no evidence or capability supports either.
criteria.statement: trap responses that invent evidence or assert unavailable context as fact

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: V2's bar, retained, but computed with the CORRECTED definition in which an empty hypothesis set is full abstention. Under V2's definition the ideal answer scored 0.0, which is why V2's gate L reading was not interpretable.
criteria.statement: starved packets answered with abstention rather than invention

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: V2 baseline is 0 of 132 = 0.0. At roughly 12 hypotheses per fixture, 0.10 is about one genuine interaction per fixture: real conditional depth, far from requiring it universally. Deliberately NOT 'at least one anywhere', which a single lucky hypothesis would satisfy.
criteria.statement: accepted hypotheses that are MEANINGFUL multi-condition proposals

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.numerator: intents with a condition whose dimension is not venue
criteria.rationale: V2 replay measured 9 of 146 = 0.062, and venue was the only dimension V2's prompt named. 0.20 is over 3x the V2 rate and still a minority of intents, so it rewards breadth of conditioning without demanding it everywhere.
criteria.statement: normalized intents carrying at least one NON-venue condition

criteria.denominator: reference fixtures where opponent_profile is AVAILABLE
criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: Availability-gated by construction. V2 replay measured 4 of 12 = 0.333 with a prompt that never mentioned `axis`. 0.50 asks for a majority of the fixtures where the dimension is genuinely offered.
criteria.statement: fixtures where opponent_profile was AVAILABLE and was actually used

criteria.fail_closed: below minimum N scores NOT MET
criteria.rationale: V2 replay measured 0.2987 bits with 140 of 146 intents on SUBJECT_OVERALL_BASELINE; the maximum over five comparisons is 2.32. 0.60 marks escape from the single-baseline collapse without demanding a uniform spread, which would itself be a forced-complexity target.
criteria.statement: Shannon entropy over the comparison mix of reference intents, in bits

stop_rule.denominator_definition: completed calls so far, in frozen seq order, across every control arm
stop_rule.name: WHOLE_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_REJECTION_STOP
stop_rule.numerator_definition: completed calls whose whole-response failure is EXACTLY 'SCHEMA_INVALID'. A NUMERICAL_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION, a LATENT_GRADING_VIOLATION or a per-hypothesis rejection does NOT count: those are discipline results the experiment exists to measure, and halting on them would destroy the measurement.
on_trip: STOP inference immediately; issue no further calls
PRESERVE every completed call, its raw response and its provenance
WRITE the execution ledger with stop_triggered=true and the tripping checkpoint
DO NOT salvage, repair or partially accept any malformed response
DO NOT compute a PASS/MIXED/FAIL verdict from the partial battery
DO NOT alter the schema, prompt or contract and resume under this experiment id; a changed contract is a different experiment and requires a new experiment id
stop_rule.threshold_rationale: 0.25 is the documented historical base rate: 16 of the 64 frozen V2 responses carry at least one contract-invalid condition and would be whole-rejected under schema-v2. V3's model is SHOWN the closed enum in its tool spec, so 0.25 is exactly the 'no better than V2' line. Reaching it means contract exposure did not work, which is an infrastructure/prompt failure rather than a result about the model's research ability.

what_this_is_not: NOT a test of whether any hypothesis is statistically true
NO hypothesis becomes a predictive feature
NO deterministic effect estimation is part of this experiment
